note: A sample iso_tile order: a small yard (a paved floor, a lawn, a plank wall and its north twin, a low fence, a crate and a bush) remade from the synthetic sprites of tests/iso_tile_synth.py, which the tests write under local/fixtures/iso_tile/.

style.global: Hand-painted game art, rich natural detail, soft natural colours.
style.view_tile_floor: A flat straight-down orthographic texture filling the whole square picture, flat even light, matte.
style.view_tile_wall: A flat straight-on orthographic view of the wall's face filling the whole picture, flat even light, matte.
style.view_tile_object: The object alone as an isometric game sprite seen from above at thirty degrees, plain grey background, flat even light.
style.material_look: Flat even light, matte, high detail.
style.material_negative: text, letters, cast shadows, perspective, vignette
